# 🛵 Online Ordering & Delivery

> **Module**: Delivery | **Total Features**: 25 | **Phase 1 Count**: 2
> **Core Principle**: Own channel (zero commission) vs aggregators (25-35% commission).

---

## Features

### P0 - Must Have

**F-201: Branded Ordering Website** — Auto-generated at yourname.restroverse.com. Photo menu, cart, checkout. | Phase 2
**F-203: QR In-Restaurant Ordering** — Scan table QR → browse menu on phone → place order → arrives on POS | Phase 2
**F-209: COD Tracking** — Track cash on delivery per rider, settlement at EOD | Phase 1
**F-216: Online Payment Integration** — eSewa/Khalti (Nepal), UPI (India), bKash (BD) | Phase 1

### P1 - Should Have

**F-202: WhatsApp Ordering Bot** — Full conversational ordering via WhatsApp | Phase 3
**F-204: Delivery Zone Config** — Draw zones on map, set fee + min order + ETA per zone | Phase 2
**F-205: Own Driver Management** — Add riders, assign orders | Phase 2
**F-206: Rider GPS Tracking** — Real-time location on map | Phase 2
**F-207: AI Delivery Time Estimation** — Distance + kitchen load + rider availability | Phase 2
**F-208: Proof of Delivery** — Photo + customer OTP confirmation | Phase 2
**F-210: Aggregator Dashboard** — Foodmandu, Swiggy, Zomato on one screen | Phase 4
**F-213: Commission Tracking** — Per-order aggregator commission impact on margin | Phase 4
**F-215: Kiosk Mode** — Same tablet as customer-facing self-service | Phase 3
**F-217: Order Tracking Page** — Real-time: Confirmed → Preparing → Ready → On the Way → Delivered | Phase 2
**F-218: Delivery Analytics** — Avg time, cost, by zone, rider performance | Phase 2
**F-219: Customer Address Book** — Save + auto-suggest on repeat orders | Phase 2
**F-220: One-Tap Repeat Order** | Phase 2
**F-224: Failed Delivery Handling** — Wrong address/no answer workflow | Phase 2

### P2 - Nice to Have

**F-211: Aggregator Menu Sync** | **F-212: Auto-Accept Rules** | **F-214: Smart Routing (own vs aggregator)** | **F-221: Scheduled Orders** | **F-222: Delivery Slot Selection** | **F-223: Live Rider Chat** | **F-225: Delivery Rating**
